name: Merida SILEX 7000 25

support_note: Merida lists its official online mall, JD flagship store and Douyin flagship store as authorized online channels; exact SILEX 7000 stock/order mapping and checkout fulfilment remain unresolved.
source_note:
The exact SILEX 7000 25 mainland page and CNY 20,800 suggested retail remain separately sourced. The current manufacturer sales declaration names the official mall, JD and Douyin channels and excludes warranty for unauthorized online stores, but does not show a live SILEX 7000 listing, dealer stock or checkout.

Batch 25 current policy review: lifetime carbon-frame coverage is conditional on first-owner status, authorized-dealer purchase, valid card/proof and eligible service route. Merida China names its mall/JD/Douyin online channels and excludes unofficial online purchases. This does not prove the retained SILEX lead qualifies.

Batch 35 recheck: the current exact SILEX 7000 25 page names a carbon CF2 II frame and CF2 carbon fork but no grade or lay-up. Recent review evidence remains ride-impression evidence; older 2023 stiffness comments do not establish the current generation/build, and no measured stiffness result was found.

facts.frame: SILEX CF2 II carbon with carbon fork
facts.frame_material: Exact SILEX 7000 25 page identifies the CF2 II frame and SILEX II CF2 fork as carbon; fiber grade and lay-up are not published.
facts.frame_construction: Dropped-chainstay carbon chassis with hidden cable routing and multiple frame/fork mounts; the exact page also presents Merida Nano-carbon and AWS anti-wrinkle technologies without publishing a model-specific lay-up or test protocol
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured stiffness result for the current exact model/build was found. The older 2023 non-stock build's reported stiffness is generation/build-mismatched; recent reviews do not publish a comparable stiffness measurement.
facts.complete_weight_basis: Exact-model public-post measurement of an approximately 9.8 kg size-M complete bike; pedals, accessories and weighing method are not stated
facts.sizes: XXS, XS, S, M, L, XL
